description: This file manages the integration of a settings store for hot-reloading Tlon plugin configuration in an Urbit environment. It defines types for pending approvals and settings, functions for parsing and updating settings, and a manager for subscribing to and handling settings changes.

methods.name: parseChannelRules
methods.description: Parses channel rules from JSON string or object format, handling nested objects stored as JSON strings.

methods.name: parseSettingsResponse
methods.description: Parses the raw response from Urbit's settings store into a structured TlonSettingsStore object.

methods.name: isChannelRulesObject
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a value is a valid channel rules object.

methods.name: parsePendingApprovals
methods.description: Parses pending approval requests from JSON string or array format into an array of PendingApproval objects.

methods.name: parseSettingsEvent
methods.description: Parses a settings event to extract key-value updates for the settings store.

methods.name: applySettingsUpdate
methods.description: Applies a single key-value update to the current settings state.
